svg.title: Diagonal with Curve II
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Observed slate-gray shaped canvas: convex upper boundary, straight lower diagonal and short upright ends. Oblique source photograph approximately rectified using museum overall dimensions; vivid gray is not calibrated.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://artbma.org/artwork/diagonal-with-curve-ii/; source object 1979.32; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
